stop: Stop when the exploratory knee calibration (cal 0-599) and the confirmatory C-GATE rows (conf_test 3040-5039 at severities 0-3) are complete or the owner cap is reached. Nobody opens conf labels before 2026-11-26 01:45Z.
_doc: Role stress, lineage cfcap-stress. Task stress_gate (cfcap/t2/gate_task.py, constructions of cfcap/t2/gate.py = theory E1 with T2 truth and T2 probe observations). gate-cal is EXPLORATORY (split cal, root 92599/97): scripts/stress_conf_gate.py margins fits robust / lawcal / par margins from it and the json is committed before export. conf-gate: confirmatory, seed root 92599/22, the same 2000 episodes at every severity; shard 0 = exploratory spare.

groups.name: gate-cal
groups.pilot: stress 2026-11-25: python -m cfcap.runner stress_gate --task-spec cfcap.t2.gate_task:TASK --shard 0 --n-shards 1 --out /tmp/gt --split test --start 10 --stop 12 --per-unit 2 --root 1,1 (4070 host, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4, CPU only): 6.0 s for 2 episodes x 4 severities (240 rows); a single E1-sized episode with 15 children x 2 severities took 8.2 s, so ~8-16 s per episode at 4 severities; a 10-episode unit ~80-160 s at 4 threads; RSS < 1.5 GB, VRAM 0.
groups.purpose: Exploratory T2 knee-law calibration episodes (generator cal split, severities 0-3) on which the C-GATE robust, lawcal and par margins are fitted before any confirmatory row is read.

groups.purpose: Confirmatory C-GATE in T2: conf_test 3040-5039 under theory's knee law at severities 0-3 (paired, seed root 92599/22), truth with the fixed reference, the two-constant fit and identified-set bounds at v2 and v2+clamp, closed-form dominance flags; shard 0 is an unscored spare.
